listings.rawTitle: Anna Sui Flight of Fancy Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: This scent brings the explosion of luminous Java lemon, litchi, and yuzu notes, followed with soft notes of Star Magnolia, rose blossom, and waves of Purple Rain Freesia. The bottom notes end the composition with amber crystals, light wood, and skin musk, bringing peace and tranquillity.

listings.rawTitle: Anna Sui Secret Wish Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Secret Wish expresses Anna Suir's own magical optimism -- wishing will make it so. All things are possible; one has only to ask. Only to reveal a hidden, innermost wish. And, from somewhere beneath a blue bell, a new fragrance spirit emerges.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Havana Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Created in 1994 by Aramis, Havana Aftershave is a sexy, masculine fragrance with a rich scent of rum and tobacco. This is a truely seductive and intoxicating cologne, suitable for romantic use.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Adventurer Eau de Toilette 110ml Spray
listings.description: Offering a daring foray into woody aromatic fragrances, Adventurer by Aramis provides a lively scent that perfectly compliments the courageous and hardy man who tackles the world head-on, daring to experience a challenging and exciting world. A sharp, zesty accord of lemon, bergamot and black pepper tops the fragrance with a kick. A core of bitter wormwood, lavender and geranium gives the heart a deep aromatic vibe and, finally, a base of patchouli, cedar and seawood provides a grounding, savoury finish.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Voyager Eau de Toilette 110ml Spray
listings.description: An aromatic spicy fragrance for men, opening with top notes of ginger, juniper berries, and black pepper; heart notes of nutmeg, sage, and lavender; and a base of tonka bean.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Aramis Eau de Toilette 110ml Spray
listings.description: Created by Aramis in 1965 this self-titled fragrance, Aramis is a refined masculine scent that possesses a blend of rich spices, sandalwood, leather, moss and clove. It is recommended for evening wear.

listings.rawTitle: Aramis Aramis Eau de Toilette 240ml Spray
listings.description: Created by Aramis in 1965 this self-titled fragrance, Aramis is a refined masculine scent that possesses a blend of rich spices, sandalwood, leather, moss and clove. It is recommended for evening wear.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Blossom Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Euphoria Blossom by Calvin Klein is a sparkling, citrus, casual fragrance for the modern woman. It has top notes of kumquat, dewy green accord pomegrante, a heart of orchid blossom, lotus blossum pink peony petals woods, amber musk at the base.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Calvin Klein Eternity is an exciting revolution in the modern world of perfume. Like a soft melody, Eternity for women plays with the fragrance notes and creates a memorable perfume composition. The fragrance tones are quite feminine in style, with the floral scent prominent in the chic bottle of Eternity Calvin Klein. The sophisticated yet timelessly elegant and simple scent is what we love about the Calvin Klein brand. Eternity for women steps even higher by delivering a mixture of a bouquet of beautiful flowers and the spicy nuances of golden amber and sandalwood. Opening the bottle is like the exhilaration and anticipation that a woman feels when she finds her true love. The intertwining notes of lilies, white roses, violets, and the gentle essences of spicy notes dance like two soulmates that were destined to be together. Let the music of Calvin Klein Eternity take over and sweep you off your feet with the deep emotions of passion and love hidden in this prestige perfume scent.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK One Shock For Him Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=WUEM3VB]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} CK One Shock was created by noted perfumers Ann Gottlieb, Loc Dong and IFF.  This eau de toilette presents as a masculine and alluring aromatic that includes ingredients clementine and purple lavender on top,  a middle of cardamon and osmanthus, and a bottom of patchouli, musk, chocolate, and tobacco.   When first applied a fresh slightly citrusy aroma may be noted, perhaps with a hint of rose as well, soon to be enriched with tobacco, musk, and chocolate undertones. The complete effect is a woodsy appealing scent that is hard to resist.   Calvin Klein, the leading global lifestyle company, has long been a leader in the perfume/cologne market, having achieved great success with its CK One Unisex release in 1994. 2011's follow-up, One Shock for Him 200ml, reaffirmed One Shock's position with men, featuring a new carefully blended fragrance representative of CK's modern and authentic style.   One Shock for Him, created for you.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Euphoria a fragrance from Calvin Klein, has top notes of pomegranate, persimmon and lush green accord within the heart imparts a mysterious and intoxicating feeling through notes of rich black orchid, dewy lotus blossom and sensual champaca flower. The drydown provides a lasting signature of liquid amber, black violet, cream accord and mahogany wood.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Secret Obsession Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Secret Obsession explores the secrets that lie between love and madness. It's about being taunted with illicit thoughts and compelled with seeking pleasure.An oriental floral composed of exotic plum, nutmeg, rose de damask, Egyptian jasmine, orange blossom, tuberose, cashmere woods, vanilla, burnt amber and Australian sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Moment Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A fresh squeezed floral bursting with succulent beauty. The Eternity Moment fragrance blooms with the lush sensuality of dew-kissed, fresh florals.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Free Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: CK Free by Calvin Klein. This is a aromatic and woody fragrance for men. It contains of star anise, jackfruit, absinthe, juniper berry, suede, tobacco leaves, coffee absolute, South African buchu, patchouli absolute, oak wood, cedar wood and Costa Rican ironwood.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK Be Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: CK Be by Calvin Klein. This is a fresh, floral, aromatic and woody fragrance for both men and women. It contains of bergamot, mandarin, juniper, lavender, peppermint, green notes, jasmine, orchid, freesia, magnolia, peach, cedar, amber, musk, sandal and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsession for Men Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=V029VGI]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Calvin Klein Obsession for Men Eau de Parfum captures the pure essence of masculinity. Potent, powerful, and provocative, it's a compelling, intense blend of botanics, spices, and rare woods. Potent and sensual, Calvin Klein Obsession for Men is an eau de parfum that awakens inner strength. Composed of a compelling blend of botanics, spices, and rare woods, it embodies the pure essence of masculinity. Driven by passion, Obsession for Men exudes the determination and fire powerful men are made of. Notorious, unforgettable, and provocative, it's a sexy interpretation of limitless potential. A warm, woody base of musk, sandalwood, and vetiver completes the powerful scent.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK IN2U Him Eau de Toilette 150ml Spray
listings.description: Fresh but warm; a tension that creates sexiness.Spontaneous - sexy - connectedCK IN2U him is a fresh woody oriental that penetrates with lime gin fizz and rushes into a combination of cool musks that radiate from top to bottom and leaves you wanting more.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK One Red Edition for Him Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Taking the original CK One fragrance and injecting a stylish new edge to its iconic spirit, CK One Red for Him features notes of juicy red pear, ginger, heated black pepper and tonka bean.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Truth Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Calvin Klein Truth is a refreshing, oriental, woody fragrance. This scent contains a fresh natural blend of rich woods that react to individual skin chemistry. It is recommended as a daytime fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Deep Euphoria Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: This fragrance from Calvin Klein was released in 2016 and although it is part of the Euphoria range, it is described as being a separate fragrance and brings a completely new composition with it. Its top notes are white pepper, mandarin leaf and cascalone, middle notes of jasmine sambac, geranium, peony and black rose and ends with patchouli, musk and woody notes.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Endless Euphoria Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: This fragrance opens up with a light breeze of cherry blossom, refreshed with mandarin and bergamot. Pastel rose and violet form the day-dream inspired heart of the perfume, and it's followed by its gentle and sensual base of bamboo, sandalwood and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Escape For Men Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Created by Calvin Klein in 1993, Escape is a refreshing, spicy, lavender, amber fragrance. This masculine scent contains a blend of apple, plum, peach, bergamot, juniper, rosemary and is accented with sage, mandarin and sandalwood making ESCAPE perfect for everyday use.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Aqua Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Eternity Aqua for Women is described as a modern fragrance that wraps you with its casual elegance, charm and a touch of mystery. Its character is fresh aquatic, as the name suggests, enriched with woody accords and notes of light flowers.It opens with an explosive mix of Pink Lady apple, cucumber, apricot and white peony. Modern bouquet of white flowers is at the heart of the perfume, including jasmine, tiare, gardenia and magnolia. Sensual sun-drenched woods, cedar and transparent musk are located in the base.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein CK All Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: A refreshing citrus fragrance, first launched in early 2017. The scent features top notes of: mandarin, bergamot and grapefruit blossom; middle notes of jasmine, lily, rhubarb and freesia; and base notes of musk, vetiver and warm amber.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Aqua Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Eternity Aqua captures the essence of today's modern man - expressing himself and his relationships in a way that is truly reflective of his life.He approaches life and love with an easy confidence - combined with an effortless elegance and an unforced charm, making it all look so simple.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Aqua Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Night Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A dark and mysterious fragrance from Calvin Klein. Released in 2014, Eternity Night for men opens with coriander seed, plum and a sprinkling of paprika. A floral heart using notes of clary sage, violet and lavender gives the fragrance an aromatic core. Finally the scent weaves together sandalwood, cedar and vetiver for a solid woody base.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity Now Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 2015, this floral fragrance begins with top notes of litchi, quince, and sorbet; heart notes of peony, peach blossom, and neroli; and base notes of cashmere wood, ambroxan, and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: Calvin Klein Euphoria for women is an oriental fragrance that contrasts exotic fruits, seductive florals and a rich, creamy signature. Containing top notes of pomegranate, succulent persimmon and a lush green accord; middle notes of black orchid, dewy lotus blossom and champaca flower and base notes of liquid amber, black violet, sensual musks, mahogany wood and a cream accord.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Euphoria For Him Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray Travel Set
listings.description: The Euphoria Men fragrance from Calvin Klein was launched in the year of 2006, this scent is addictive fresh and oriental with an intriguing freshness and modern sensuality. Top notes of ginger pepper cocktail, raindrop accord and chilled sudachi. An aromatic heart of black basil, cedar leaf and hydroponic sage. A sensual drydown of creamy suede, addictive patchouli, brazilian redwood and solid amber.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsession Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: <p class="p1">Obsession is one of the best perfumes ever launched. There is little wonder why so many of us have this exciting scent in our arsenal of fragrances. It is hard to believe it was first released in 1985. Thanks to its blend of tones of oriental spices, Calvin Klein Obsession remains as contemporary today as it did back then. It would be fair to say that it is a must-have perfume.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p class="p1">Although packed with exciting tones, the scent is subtle enough for daytime wear. However, it is during the evening or night the perfume comes into its own. As it drifts through the cooler night air, you will instantly recognise it.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p class="p1">The 100ml bottle looks smooth and cool, and will never look out of place on any dressing table or in a bathroom cabinet. Obsession Perfume is the gift or personal fragrance choice that keeps on giving. No one will be disappointed by a gift of the fragrance. Needless to say, it also makes a fantastic perfume treat for yourself if it does not already sit on your dressing table.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p>

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsession for Men Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Calvin Klein Obsession for Men is the pure essence of masculinity. Potent, powerful, and intensely provocative, this scent is a compelling blend of botanicals, spices, and rare woods. Designed in 1986, Obsession cologne for men is a refreshing, oriental, woody fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Obsession Night Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A fragrance for the young, sophisticated, approachable, vivacious woman, Obsession Night was created for the risk-taker who is unafraid of experimentation. This delicious fruity blend of citrus, fresh flowers, sexy vanilla, and elegant amber captures the warmth and intensity of the night and the woman who shines.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=YS2VDCR]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Calvin Klein Sheer Beauty is an ageless classic. The sexy, warm, floral essence has led to the popularity of this scent. The opening notes of this fragrance are an airy veil of sweet flowers combined with delicious berries, fresh peaches, and crisp bergamot. The middle notes include sweet peony, subtle lily, and sensual jasmine. The base consists of deep woodsy sandalwood, earthy musk, and rich vanilla blossom.   The sweet floral-fruity bouquet mixed with the richness of vanilla makes it a great fragrance for everyday wear. The warm sexy ora of citrusy bergamot, rich jasmine, and sandalwood make it a perfect Eau de Toilette for evening wear. The addition of musk leads to the longevity of the smell so that you have to reapply less often. The combination of all of these luscious scents makes Sheer Beauty Calvin Klein 100ml an excellent choice for every occasion.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: <p>Azzaro Wanted is looking for you, the sophisticated man ready to take on the world. It wants you, the charismatic Don Juan, who lives life on the edge. Celebrate life with this powerful bottle of seduction and strength. Let the Wanted aftershave arouse that which you crave.</p> <p>This bold fragrance gets driven by spicy, citrus, and woody notes, radiating a desire for the man who wears it. The Wanted man oozes confidence and independence as he instinctively pursues his passions and wins. Dare to be invincible with Azzaro Wanted 100ml.</p> <p>Even the bottle drips with masculine sex appeal with its metallic contours that scream your name. Its unique shape begs for you to rip its cap off and basque in its aromatic luxury.</p>

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Wanted Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: Introducing Azzaro 'Wanted' an audacious and flamboyant new fragrance for men. It is a woody, citrus and spicy eau de toilette with a fresh, sensual and captivating masculinity. A fragrance of vibrant and explosive brings freshness, unfolding into a bold spicy accord revealing a radiant and spirited personality. Its sensual woody notes establish a new elegant and captivating masculinity.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Club Women Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: An oriental fragrance opening with top notes of pomegranate and passion fruit; middle note of cashmere wood; and base notes of vanilla and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Club Men Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: A woody aromatic fragrance that opens with top notes of lemon and papaya; middle note of cannabis; and base notes of hinoki and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Chrome Legend Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 2007 Chrome Legend is a follow-up to 1996's Chrome, and is described as 'a more sophisticated fragrance'.The notes include tea, green apple, bitter orange, musk, moss, sea spray, cedar, vetiver, amber and tonka bean.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Chrome Intense Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Azzaro Chrome Intense opens with a citrusy union of bergamot and grapefruit, creating sparkling chords embellished with tart ginger and hedione molecule. The heart develops notes of ozone, jasmine water and lichen, while the base is created of precious wood, mate, amber and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Chrome Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Built on a dominant citrus and musk accord, the fragrance arouses freshness and vigor. A gentle aquatic note is added to this opening aroma, followed by a woody end note mixed with shades of 'tea'. Top note: Lemon, Petitgrain, Rosemary, Pineapple. Middle note : Coriander, Jasmine, Cyclamen, Orris. Base note : Cedarwood, Moss, Tonka, Musk. The packaging is adorned in Mediterranean steel-blue, a symbol of purity, and a silver metal color for refinement and perfection. It is made of transparent glass, with a chevron top in the shape of a horsewoman.

listings.rawTitle: Azzaro Chrome Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VAV10CF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Introducing Azzaro Chrome the new Eau de Toilette for men. Azzaro Chrome features fresh notes of bergamot, grapefruit and ginger, aquatic notes of transparent musks and comforting notes of amber, sandalwood and maté leaves to create a blend of intense and enveloping freshness.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Florabotanica Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Inspired by a strange and wonderful garden in which you do not know whether the flowers are innocent or poisonous, Florabotanica from Balenciaga evokes the 18th Century botanical gardens in which the most exotic and rarest plant species were displayed. Strange-coloured plants discovered in distant countries brought back from their travels by enthusiastic biologists.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga B Balenciaga Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Fresh and alluring, the fragrance opens with green notes of edamame and lily of the valley bell. As B.BALENCIAGA evolves, the iris note reveals a powdery essence before drying down with darker woody notes of cashmeran woods.

listings.rawTitle: Balenciaga Paris Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Balenciaga Paris is a lovely paradox. It is a perfume that becomes life, that melds with living. Wear Balenciaga Paris and become a close yet inaccessible woman who strolls under leafy arbors. Balenciaga Paris opens with demure notes of violet make this a light, floral and pleasing scent. Balenciaga Paris then moves into peppery notes that reveal themselves and evoke a scent of calm, mossy wood. Balenciaga Paris is a fragrance full of light with a few dark apertures that create a complex and intoxicating allure.

listings.rawTitle: Beyonce Heat Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Beyoncé Heat Fragrance Collection Catch the fever with Beyoncé Heat, the first fragrance by Beyoncé. Sensual. Sexy. Sophisticated. Beyoncé Heat is an alluring, feminine fragrance featuring rare sensual flowers created for the modern woman exuding confidence, sexiness and energy. Let yourself feel the heat.

listings.rawTitle: Clinique Aromatics in White Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A women&rsquo;s fragrance which lures with tart notes of Sichuan pepper, elegant violet leaves and labdanum in top notes. The gentle transition towards the heart comes with floral shades of roses and orange blossom, surrounded with patchouli, creating a harmonious union of floral and earthy textures. Depth and sensual aromas are ensured by leather musk, intertwined with warm grey amber, benzoin and vanilla. United this way, they leave a soft, oriental signature in the base.

listings.rawTitle: Clinique Happy Eau de Cologne 100ml Spray
listings.description: Clinique Happy For Men is one of the more interesting male scents available. When you are thinking about buying the man in your life a cologne, you should include this one on the list. Yes, it has a distinct masculine scent, but at the same time, it offers something different. In short, there is a reason why it is called Happy - it is truly uplifting. The fragrance is vanilla based, but as you let it linger, you will also pick up masculine undertones such as sandalwood and musk. It is Clinique Happy special blend that makes it stand among other men's scents and fragrances. As Happy was initially launched as a female scent, it is easy to presume that the 100ml bottle will be geared towards the fairer sex. Take a closer look, and you will find the bottle has a clear unisex feel which makes perfect for a man's bathroom shelf. Buy it as a present or why not buy it for yourself. This is one of the scents the ladies really do appreciate.

listings.rawTitle: Clinique Happy Cologne Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=XYHK6TM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Clinique Happy Cologne Eau De Toilette is a crisp, cool and refreshing EDT for men recommended for daytime wear. Heart Notes: Green Notes. Base Notes: Cedar, Mediterranean Cypress and Guaiacwood.

listings.rawTitle: Clinique Aromatics Elixir Eau de Parfum 45ml Spray
listings.description: Something far and beyond, Aromatics Elixir touches the senses and spirit in subtle, pleasing ways. This perfume appeals to the individual in every woman.

listings.rawTitle: Aspen Aspen Cologne 118ml Spray
listings.description: Aspen for men cologne by Coty helps you exude a subtle masculinity. The outdoorsy scents of citrus and woods mingle with a hint of spice to create a clean and confident fragrance, perfect for a day at the office or an outing with friends. Aspen has been a popular signature scent for many men since its introduction in 1989. It can add a touch of rugged elegance to everyday business activities or freshen up an afternoon spent enjoying the great outdoors.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Champion Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Brimming with power, Davidoff Champion is a fragrance that unlocks your hidden potential for victory. Released in 2010 as a fragrance for men this fresh and rejuvenating scent introduces citrus opening accords of lemon and bergamot. Its heart is enriched with clary sage in union with galbanum, while the base closes with cedar and oak moss.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Champion Energy Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Affirming a more energetic side of it's predecessor fragrance, Davidoff Champion Energy is a powerful fragrance that charges your zeal, daring and vigour. An outburst of juicy citrus, bergamot and grapefruit, creates a lively opening. A fiery heart kindles fresh spices with a blade of tonic. The base brings in a deeper allure with woody cedar and rugged oak moss.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: <p class="p1">Davidoff Cool Water is a male scent that has stood the test of time. When you encounter it for the first time, you may experience the scent as slightly cool. However, once on the skin, Cool Water goes onto develop its full range of pleasurable tones. It transforms from cool, to sexy. Maybe that is why it is one of the world's best loved scents.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p class="p1">When you are looking for a male scent that will take you through the day and still carry on doing its job at night, Cool Water Davidoff is the perfect choice. It will remind you of refreshing sea breezes that blow in from the ocean on a warm summer's night.</p> <p class="p1">The 125ml bottle really tells you what the scent is all about. It would be fair to say that it looks cool and utterly masculine. As a complete package, it is really the complete package as they say. Buy it as a gift or as a scent for yourself. It is certainly a fragrance that will keep on delivering.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p>

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Night Dive Women Eau de Toilette 80ml Spray
listings.description: This fresh fragrance opens with fruity notes of Italian mandarin, which leads to the heart of the scent created by jasmine and Pistachio. All wrapped in a warm base of amber, patchouli and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Woman Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=N17GXDI]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Experience the refreshing elegance of Davidoff Cool Water for Women Eau de Toilette (100ml), a fragrance that captures the spirit of the ocean with a distinctly feminine touch. Inspired by the serene movement of waves, this scent brings together a vibrant mix of fruity and floral elements to create a scent that feels both invigorating and effortlessly sensual. Combining the crisp freshness of the original men’s Cool Water with a softer, more delicate profile, this fragrance opens with a lively burst of pineapple, watermelon, quince, blackcurrant, and lemon. First introduced in 1996, Cool Water for Women remains a timeless classic, presented in an elegant, wave-inspired blue bottle adorned with silver accents. The design reflects its oceanic inspiration, making it not only a captivating scent but also a beautiful addition to any fragrance collection.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Silver Shadow Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: The Davidoff man lives life to the fullest. His experience and maturity give him an extraordinary charisma. He leaves behind him a mysterious fragrance trail; intoxicating and unforgettable. His fragrance is his signature, a fascinating shadow of his personality. Introducing Silver Shadow by Davidoff. Base notes of intense amber and oakmoss, a heart of saffron and patchouli, and top notes of orange, coriander and cedar leaves combine to create a timeless elegance with style... an unforgettable trail. The timelessly modern bottle is an object of intriguing beauty.

listings.rawTitle: Davidoff Cool Water Night Dive For Men Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Elie Saab Le Parfum Rose Couture Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden 5th Avenue Eau de Parfum 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=URWIS0L]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Elizabeth Arden 5th Avenue Eau de Parfum is a luxurious and classic fragrance that captures the energy and sophistication of New York. listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Beauty Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Created by Elizabeth Arden in 2002. Beauty is a refreshing, crystalline, oriental, woody fragrance suitable for office wear and every day occasions. Top notes of iris, bergamot, and rice flower. Middle notes of orchid, ginger, rhubarb, lotus and lily. Base notes of sandalwood, amber and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Sunflowers Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A light fragrance for casual wear that combines melon, peach, rose and moss scents. A bright, light-hearted, happy celebration of the simplicity and joy of summer. listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden True Love Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Created in 1994, True Love is a refreshing, gentle, floral fragrance recommended for romantic occasions. This feminine aroma contains a blend of jasmine, lotus, iris and is accented with narcisse, sandalwood and vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Untold Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A luxurious and modern rendition of a sensuous floral composition, Elizabeth Arden Untold Eau de Parfum celebrates the sophistication and intrigue of the multi-faceted modern woman. From her vibrant optimism to her refined femininity, mysterious aura and magnetic sensuality, Untold takes you on a journey through the many facets of a woman that together, make her genuinely beautiful. A sparkling and fruity introduction, a radiant floral heart and a mysterious addictive warmth, this fragrance captures all that a woman is. Top Notes: Black Currant, Bergamot, Pink Pepper, Pear. Heart Notes: Gardenia, Peony, Jasmine and base Notes: Sandalwood, Patchouli Heart, Musk and Amber.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden Red Door Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: This elegant, sensuous blend of deep, rich florals features a captivating scent that fills the senses. Top notes of ylang ylang, rose and fruity nuances merge with middle notes of rare oriental orchid, jasmine, lily of the valley, Moroccan orange flowers, forest lilies, freesia, carnation and a touch of wild violets. The romantic final notes leave a sensual impression of oakmoss, sandalwood, vetiver, a hint of honey and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Taylor Diamonds & Sapphires Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Launched by the design house of Elizabeth Taylor in 1993, Diamonds & Sapphires is a refreshing, flowery fragrance. This aroma blends lily of the valley, rose, ylang- ylang, spices, jasmine and a fresh floral bouquet.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Taylor Passion For Him Eau de Cologne 118ml Spray
listings.description: Launched by the design house of Elizabeth Taylor in 1989, Passion for Men is a refined, oriental, woody fragrance. This masculine scent possesses a blend of ginger, clove oil, nutmeg, jasmine and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Taylor White Diamonds Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: White Diamonds, launched in 1991, has top notes of neroli, lily and tuberose, middle notes of orris and amber and base notes of sandalwood, patchouli and oak moss.

listings.rawTitle: Escada Agua Del Sol Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Introduced in 2016, this sweet floral fruity fragrance begins with sweet and sharp, icy raspberry sorbet combines with nashi pear granita to create mouth-watering top notes; touches of energizing pink peppercorn bring a pop of spice to the fragrance; and the warm and sensual combination of tonka bean, sandalwood and white musk cream forms a comforting blend.

listings.rawTitle: Escada Island Kiss Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Escada Island Kiss is a fragrance inspired by Caribbean beaches, fragrant coasts, salty air and lush notes of fruit and flower. Top notes include orange, passion flower and mango highlighting that this is an exotic edition refreshed with aquatic, juicy and fruity peach notes combined with magnolia in the heart. The base adds woody notes and sensual musk.

listings.rawTitle: Escada Especially Escada Elixir Intense Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Especially Escada Elixir is a powerful interpretation of the rose fragrance that is Especially Escada. Unlike its first re-adaptation, Especially Escada Delicate Notes, the Especially Elixir fragrance represents its intense version. This fragrance stands for boldly elegant women, who radiates confidence and brightens the room with her energy and smile.This mysterious rose scent begins with pear, ambrette seed and grapefruit. The heart includes Turkish rose absolut, ylang-ylang, accords of prune and fresh plums, laid on a base of patchouli, white musk, dry amber, cashmere and Madagascar

listings.rawTitle: Escada Especially Escada Delicate Notes Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Especially Escada Delicate Notes by Escada. This is a fresh and floral fragrance for women. It contains of wild rose, grapefruit, pear, rose, ylang-ylang, ambrette seed, musk and woody notes.

listings.rawTitle: Escada Especially Escada Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: The luxurious combination of rose and Ylang radiate a fresh and natural aura of positivity; the uplifting ingredients synonymous with joy and happiness.Light musky notes to support the delicate floral bouquet complete the scent adding a subtle touch of femininity.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Pi Neo Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A visionary man who ventures from the real world into a virtual world, a man about to enter the fourth dimension.The Pi Neo hero is thirsty for knowledge.He defies the time-space equation, on a quest for a new dimension where everything is possible, setting out to conquer new space, where reality and virtuality merge to infinity.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=HS06YEX]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Choose to live a spontaneous life with the Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Toilette, an alluring floral fragrance for women. Even more endearing than her magical smile, this flirtatious scent was made for a provocative woman. When you're touched by her presence, she's hard to resist. Her eyes sparkle with spontaneity, whilst her signature scent lingers with delight. Similar to its wearer, this playful fragrance exudes innocence, charm and complete irresistibility. Blended with the beauty of five delicate roses, a dominate burst of flower power storms open the scent. Accentuated by sparkling verbena, the elegant core of centifolia and peony rose toy with the velvet petals of passion and fantasia rose, creating an elegant affair for all to enjoy. Notes: Star Anise, Verbena Leaf, Centifolia Rose, Peony Rose, Passion Rose, Fantasia Rose, Emotion Rose

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Xeryus Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Xeryus by Givenchy is a Aromatic Fougere fragrance for men. Xeryus was launched in 1986. Top notes are lavender, green notes, mandarin orange, violet, jasmine, nutmeg flower, ylang-ylang, lily-of-the-valley, bergamot, rose and lemon; middle notes are cyclamen, coriander, carnation, cypress, sandalwood, juniper berries, cinnamon, tarragon, petitgrain and geranium; base notes are leather, amber, musk, oakmoss, balsam fir, vetiver, incense and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Ysatis Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Created by Givenchy in 1985, Ysatis is an elegant, soft, woody fragrance. This feminine scent contains a blend of mandarin, oak moss, rose, iris, vanilla, clove and amber and is suitable for daytime wear.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Very Irresistible Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=NOO5153]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Sensual, indulgent fragrance featuring a special twist: a floral quintet of five elegant roses interpose a spicy head of anise and a comforting base of vanilla and patchouli. This enchanting fragrance offers a rich sampling of roses along a trail of freshness and soft spice.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentlemen Eau de Toilette Intense 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=T5MWJYM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} If you’re a fan of the GIVENCHY Gentleman collection, you’re bound to love this latest addition. The Intense Eau de Toilette possesses all of the artisanal qualities of a true Gentleman fragrance; it’s both refined and classic. For fans of the original, you’ll recognise the iconic bottle design, which has been coloured in a black-to-blue ombre that shows the contrast of sweet blue iris and woods inside this scent. What makes this addition different to the GIVENCHY Gentleman Eau de Parfum? You can expect a green, fresher signature!

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Live Irresistible Eau de Toilette 75ml Spray
listings.description: Your mood- Happy and Irrésistible. Your motto- Join my happiness! Your fragrance- A floral and fruity cocktail, sparkling and juicy. Seize the moment, share your happiness and rewrite all the rules, leaving just one: Live Irrésistible.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Play Intense Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray

Coffee Wood, Pink Pepper and Amyris Wood compose the fluttering heart and give it a sensuous tone. The trail of Tonka Bean, Vetiver and Patchouli shows off a woody-oriental hint and the confidence is evident in his stride.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Xeryus Rouge Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Y25LMU1]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Warm and intense, Xeryus Rouge is a classic, Woody Amber designed for a man who embraces his freedom and is a risk-taker at heart. Succulent kumquat and green cactus are dusted with red pepper and crushed cedar wood for a seductive scent that lingers. Woody Amber Top Notes: Kumquat, Green Cactus Heart Note: Red Pepper Base Note: Cedar Wood

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=E58V0YF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} A woody-aromatic scent, rich with spice notes, mingled with Russian leather, it makes a statement. The fragrance combines vigour and character, thanks to the alliance of vetiver, tarragon and cinnamon. The inspiration is a confident, contemporary and determined man, who represents timeless, masculine seduction. Givenchy Gentleman is a modern man, elegant and proud of his appearance.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Insense Ultramarine Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Intense Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 150ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=REHBS2M]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Guilty pour Homme by Gucci is an aromatic, woody fragrance for men. Gucci gave us something positive, in the form of a clean fragrance built on a refreshing blend of lemon and lavender, followed by precious notes of African orange flower before the scent dries down on a comfortable base of cedar and patchouli. Gucci Guilty comes in a luxurious masculine grey bottle, with a robust base of metal and glass on the top. The bottle reflects the scent; it is a strong aroma that is perfect for evening wear but at the same time inoffensive enough to be worn in the office.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme is carefully designed for men who know what they want and who get what they want. The charismatic alpha male, a true magnet for ladies, is represented in this provocative and seductive composition. The fragrance opens with lavender and lemon, leaving enough space for very appealing scents of orange blossom. Basic tones are supported by warm woody accords of cedar and patchouli, offering a firm but exciting and soft coloring to the whole composition.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Pour Homme Intense Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: The scent seizes hold of the senses with a heady fix of bracing Italian lemon and invigorating lavender, undercut with a tang of coriander. Its middle motifs persuade like an insistent invitation. Aphrodisiac orange flower - stimulating and entrancing - yields to an unexpectedly masculinity reinforcing neroli. The patchouli that is the hallmark of Gucci fragrances reaches a new potency laced with the driest amber and a leather-rich sillage - robustly earthy, yet suggestively exotic. The effect is at once remarkable and uncompromisingly alluring.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Made to Measure Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=QDTG54N]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The composition is oriental-spicy, "tailor-made" like an expensive suit. Its initial notes are inspired by the look and feel of a handmade suit; there are accords of Calabrian bergamot, Tunisian orange blossom, French lavender and aniseed. The heart is eclectic, spicy and textured, including notes of nutmeg from Sri Lanka, water lily, juniper berries, plum and cinnamon. The base is luxurious and sophisticated, made of labdanum, patchouli, leather and amber. “One further ingredient is required: the man. For a suit is merely a beautiful silhouette until its owner wears it. It is only then—when worn—that it becomes something more. Similarly, the perfume’s refined leather and rich spices combine with the warmth of the skin, the Made to Measure man’s character, and the style in which he wears it.”

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Made to Measure Eau de Toilette 50ml Spray
listings.description: The Gucci Made to Measure fragrance is intensely masculine, created for the man who demands the very best - a man whom others aspire to be. It's inspired by the Gucci Made to Measure suit, specially crafted with the Gucci philosophy of attention to detail.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Premiere Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Glamorous Magnolia Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Gucci Flora Glamorous Magnolia eau de toilette spray for women is a bright and citrus scent, opening with top notes of freesia, green leaves and citrus zest, which then fuses with a heart of peony and magnolia, all of which is rounded off with a base of musk, sandalwood and warm chocolate accord.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gracious Tuberose Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Gracious Tuberose is part of the Flora by Gucci Garden Fragrance collection, a bouquet of scents inspired by the blossoms of Grace Kelly’s legendary Gucci scarf. This green-tinged fragrance is luscious and pure, with an innocent character that caresses the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Glorious Mandarin Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Giannini describes the fragrance as a 'bouquet' of scents, including Gorgeous Gardenia to underline the gorgeously feminine side of this fragrance. Glorious Mandarin because there’s a sort of euphoria in mandarin, since it’s such a sparkly fruit.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Intense Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: The Scent opens with a natural rush that is mandarin. The middle notes reveal a blossoming of lilac, enriched with the sensual femininity of powdery violet and heliotropine.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Bloom Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Gucci Bloom is a rich white floral scent that transports to a colourful and diverse garden verdant with flowers and plants. Blended by master perfumer Alberto Morillas with direction from Alessandro Michele, the fragrance is created to unfold like its name.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Hugo Man Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: Hugo Boss Man is a clean fresh fragrance for men. Its herby tone makes it a natural fragrant scent designed to appeal to the modern man. This Hugo Boss Aftershave is a masculine oriental scent that is perfect for the liberated man who desires to be free from limitations. The fragrance conveys a vibrancy with its fresh top notes of green apple. This is matched by an underlying hit of a vibrant herbal tang from coriander seed and cardamon. These spicy additions give the unique earthy natural scent reminiscent of a walk in a wild oriental garden. The base notes of vanilla and patchouli bring warmth and passion to the fragrance. Boss Man is a deserving favourite in the Hugo Boss Perfume range for men as it gives a rich and musky aroma appealing to men who desire something which reflects their spontaneity and passion in a casual and relaxed way.

listings.rawTitle: Hugo Boss Ma Vie Intense Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=KND7PMX]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Hugo Boss Perfume has developed one of the most exciting collection of fragrances in the world. If you are looking for a scent that is different from the rest, you should explore what the brand has to offer. The brand is known for its unique approach to fragrances. Boss Ma Vie Intense, or Ma Vie to fans, is proof of everything that is good about Boss. This intense offering is packed with exciting nuances including cactus blossom. If you have ever had the privilege to smell a cactus blossom, you will know it is intense yet soft. In this fragrance, cactus blossom lingers with softer tones including white magnolia and pink roses. Everything is held together by fresh dew drops. Our 75ml eau de parfum makes the perfect personal treat. The bottle is the right size for slipping into your handbag or weekend away holder. We are delighted to offer this very exclusive scent in such a beautiful small package. Order for yourself or a friend.

L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme offers a touch of spice and mix of scented flowers at the same time. The perfect combination of notes when you want a different scent. This exquisite eau de toilette is a must have for any men. It makes a beautiful gift for any occasion. That being said, there is absolutely no reason why you should not treat yourself to this exciting scent.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey is the male scent that you can rely on to always deliver. It was created for the sophisticated man who wants his eau de toilette to differ from the rest. There is the one thing that you can say about L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme, It is one of the scents that will get you instantly noticed. What does Issey Miyake Pour Homme smell like? The fragrance is often described as woody. However, there is something more nestling among the notes. You will also pick up on a fresh aquatic tone. In many ways, it is this fresh tone that makes this scent stand out in a crowd. The finishing touches include lemon, tarragon, and bergamot. The best way to describe the scent, is as a bit of spice. The 125ml is pure elegance. When you look at it, you know that the secret to success of this men's fragrance, is contained in the bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 200ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 1993 this is a fresh yet warm, woody scent accented with spicy notes. It has top notes of juniper, bergamot and lavender, middle notes of sage, coriander and freesia and base notes of sandalwood, moss and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Femme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: This clean feminine fragrance has floral overtones made up from a wide range of flower scents including lotus, cyclamen, freesias, carnations and white lillies. Base notes are musky and woody tones.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Absolue Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=LA03FB9]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Issey Miyake perfume collections like making bold statements. When you are looking for a fragrance that is going to stand out, one of your best options is Issey Miyake l'eau d'Issey Absolue. If you are a follower of the brand and this exciting fragrance is not on your dressing table as yet, now is the perfect time to put it there. What does l'eau d'Issey Absolue smell like? The top notes are white floral followed by honey for sweetness. Then vanilla and woody notes develop accompanied by an aquatic freshness. The unique scent combination makes the fragrance for both the day and night. As an exclusive offer, we are offering this special fragrances in a 90ml eau de parfum bottle. The fragrance makes a fantastic personal purchase or gift for someone special. The bottle is the perfect size for slipping into your weekend away holder and slips easily into your handbag for days out.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pure Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=VQP3E99]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Issey Miyake perfume collections have many exciting choices that you must add to your perfume collection. Unlike many other perfume brands, the company launches far few fragrances. It only seems to launch a new scent when it thinks it has developed a fragrance which stands out. Issey Miyake l'eau d'Issey Pure is just such a scent. What does l'eau d'Issey Pure is one of the brand's more exciting offerings. When you have not added a new perfume to your collection for a while, this is the perfect choice. The scent delivers a fragrance experience which is second to none. The first notes you will pick up are amber and marine nuances soon followed by aromatic aromas. We are delighted to have the opportunity to offer this fantastic eau de parfum. You now have to decide whether you should treat yourself to it or gift it to a friend. Why not do both? Once you have opened the bottle, tearing yourself away from this unique blend of freshness and aromatic nuances is next to impossible.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau Majeure D'Issey Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A masculine strength combined with a breath of the ocean, L'Eau Majeure D'Issey features an invigorating marine fragrance that opens with crisp notes of bergamot and grapefruit. A wave of sea notes gives the fragrance an aquatic heart and a base of woods and cashmeran gives depth.

listings.rawTitle: Joop Femme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Designed in 1987, this luxurious, oriental, woody fragrance explores essences of bergamot, lemon and coriander blended with notes of jasmine, lilly of the valley and cedar.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Can't get enough couture? Well here's even more, for Juicy girls who want it all. Juicy Couture presents Viva La Juicy, an enticing scent of wild berries and mandarins, honeysuckle, gardenia, and jasmine. To round it out, amber, caramel, vanilla, sandalwood, and praline add just the right touch of sweetness. It's bottled in a bold gold decanter decorated with Juicy charms.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Peace Love & Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Peace, Love and Juicy Couture is created in a massive flacon made of heavy glass, with wonderful decorations on its neck (turquoise pearls, fluffy pink decoration and a small heart-shaped pendant with peace sign). Its composition was created by Givaudan perfumer Rodrigo Flores-Roux with such notes as Meyer lemon, wild hyacinth, sweet apple and black currant buds absolute in the top. The heart blooms with floral kisses of Sambac jasmine absolute, star magnolia, Malibu poppy, honeysuckle and linden blossom, while the base features iris root extract, patchouli blossom and sensual musk which rounds up the composition as a non-chalant embrace.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Pam and Gela wanted every girl to have her own Juicy Couture, so they made an Eau de Parfum. It comes complete with Juicy Couture's world famed J and Crown charms...so now everyone can have the charmed life, and scent, of a real live Juicy girl! Top notes: mouth-watering watermelon, mandarin, pink passion fruit, bright marigold, green apple, water hyacinth and crushed leaves. Middle notes: tuberose, wild rose and princess lily. Base notes: caramel crème brulee, vanilla, precious woods and patchouli.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture I Am Juicy Couture Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Brimming with confident attitude, I Am Juicy by Juicy Couture is the fragrance of a strong, independent and rebellious girl. Awash in sweet, juicy flavours this lively fragrance enraptures the senses with an addictive dance of fruits, white florals and warming base notes. Opening in a delicious gambit of raspberries, pomelo and passionfruit, I Am Juicy combines a gourmand selection of succulent fruits. At its core, a crowning note of addictive gardenia is draped in accents of sweet pea, rose and heliotrope. Finally a classic base combines rustic notes of wood and musk smothered in a coating of sunny amber for a finishing of comfortable, cosy warmth.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Dirty English Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Presenting the scent of irresistible bad boys all over the world. A passion-inducing mix of peppered mandarin, blue cypress, black leather, ebony wood and amber musk. Live hard, live fast, live loud, live now. It's all Dirty English, the fragrance for men.

listings.rawTitle: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Noir Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: For the woman who is sultry, daring and leaves a lasting impression. She likes her eyes smoky and her lips rouge. Never afraid to show off and get noticed, she wears this fragrance to feel confident and seduce. Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Noir Eau de Parfum embodies the limitless possibilities that the night time can bring.

listings.rawTitle: Justin Bieber Next Girlfriend Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Opening notes of Next Girlfriend accentuate sweetness, innocence, youthful dash and positive emotions. The juiciness of pineapple and velvety peach is succeeded by a fruity-floral embrace in the heart composed of passionate raspberry combined with freesia and citrusy lily of the valley. The sensual and seductive tone of the composition is provided by musk in the base.

listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Homme Classic Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: The perfume opens with aldehydes, bergamot, nutmeg, sweet orange and estragon. The heart is collected of cedarwood, intense and sweet jasmine, iris, patchouli, rose, sandalwood and tobacco. The base exposes amber, musk, oak, Tonka beans and vanilla. A casual fragrance with a light, cool sensation, scented with natural essences of cinnamon, cypress and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Karl Lagerfeld Chloe Narcisse Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 1992, this seductive feminine fragrance is a blend of exotic fruits and flowers.

listings.rawTitle: Katy Perry Royal Revolution Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Royal Revolution is tempting, royal and rebellious. This irresistible floral fragrance conquers at first breath with notes of pink freesia, mystical blackthorn, jasmine and vanilla orchid. Heart notes consist of orange flower, sandalwood, jasmine petals. The base is soft Leather, skin musk and vanilla orchid.

listings.rawTitle: Katy Perry Killer Queen Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Pop star Katy Perry launches her third fragrance and the first one done in cooperation with Coty. The scent is called Killer Queen and apparently it is totally different from its two predecessors. The bottle is shaped like a red ruby and comes in its own golden pedestal. Killer Queen was launched in 2013.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: A woody aquatic fragrance inspired by the power of the ocean. It features top notes of citruses, mint, and cardamom, heart notes of sage, marine accords, and spices, and base notes of vetiver, cedar, sandalwood, and vanilla.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Parfum D'Ete Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 1993, this refreshingly feminine, floral fragrance contains a blend of freesia, citrus and jasmine and is accented with lemon grass, vanilla and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo L'Eau Par Kenzo Pour Femme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: L'Eau Par Kenzo for women is a refreshing floral fragrance with top notes of bergamot, jasmine and freesia, middle notes of citrus, ylang-ylang and patchouhi fading down to residual notes of cedar, sandalwood and oakmoss. This floral fresh marine scent is recommended for daytime use.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo L'Eau Par Kenzo Intense Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: L`Eau Kenzo Intense Pour Homme by Kenzo is an aromatic aquatic fragrance for men. It contains notes of Japanese yuzu citrus, lime, seawater, black basil, cedar and vetiver.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo L'Eau Kenzo Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: L'Eau Kenzo is a soft, green, citrus fragrance. A transparent blend of Japanese yuzu, ho leaf, lotus leaf, mint, pepper, and musk that is ideal for the active man. The soft, fresh fragrance lingers subtly, and is never too heavy.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Jungle Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: In 1998, Kenzo created a fragrance for men with woody and citrus accords. A sensual, hybrid fragrance... Mat&eacute; is warm and sweet lime has a slight tang; they blend with generous notes of soft, spicy nutmeg and musky mallow seeds. Finally, Atlas cedar and blue cedar from Lebanon offer up sweet and woody notes.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Jungle L'Elephant Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Kenzo Jungle was the name of the first Kenzo shop in France. The elephant is the fetish animal shown in the bottle cap. A fragrance to catch the eye. A spicy composition, ideal for the cosmopolitan woman. Kenzo jungle brings us the jungle to the city. Top notes: cardamom, tangerine, cumin, cloves. Heart notes: Ylang-ylang, mango, liquorice, heliotrope. Background: patchouli, vanilla, amber, cashmere.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Jeu D'Amour Elixir Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: An oriental floral fragrance introduced as a deeper, warmer, more sensual version of the original. It opens with top notes of blackberry and Mandarin orange, heart notes of jasmine and tuberose, and base notes of rum, vanilla, patchouli, caramel, and sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Jeu D'Amour Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: The new fragrance from Kenzo collection Amor is named Jeu d'Amour and it represents edition for 2014. Daphne Bugey and Christophe Raynaud create the composition of notes of blood mandarin, pomegranate, tea, tuberose and freesia. The face of the perfume is French actress Louise Bourgoin.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower L'Eau Originelle Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A contemporary remastering of a classic fragrance, L'Eau Originelle by Kenzo released in 2015, is a modern spin on the original Flower fragrance that features fresh aquatic notes and gentle florals. In an opening of bright fresh fragrance, the scent starts with a pool of water notes splashed with ginger, bergamot and pink pepper. At the fragrance's heart it spins a floral accord comprised of peony, freesia and rose before finally drying down to a feminine base of violet and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower in The Air Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: The fragrance is a modern and light floral, created by Alberto Morillas. The top notes include fresh accords of raspberry and pink pepper. The heart includes dazzling rose, magnolia and gardenia, placed on the elegant white musk base.

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Flower Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: <p>Kenzo Flower truly is an iconic perfume. Of course the brand has other scents, but the moment someone says Kenzo, you will be excused for thinking of Kenzo Flower Perfume.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p class="p1">Yes, the fragrance is young and uplifting, but it really is a fragrance for all age groups. It is a scent that will have you dreaming of flower meadows and beautiful summer days out in no time at all.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <p class="p1">A gentle wooden touch completes Flower By Kenzo. But, the first scents you will experience include Hawthorne, roses and cassis. You will also pick up subtle notes of vanilla and wood. It is this fragrance combination that makes the fragrance so unique.</p> <p class="p1">Both the packaging and the 100ml bottle are instantly recognisable. Branding and styling are two major selling points. Anybody will be delighted to receive this scent as a gift. And if you think the bottle would look stylish on your dresser, why not buy as a personal special gift for yourself.<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p>

listings.rawTitle: Kenzo Amour Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=MLM4AVM]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} The slow and sensuous journey of a couple through Asia, punctuated by encounters, bursts of laughter and smiles, soft sensations, pictures and perfumes brimming with life. A bird accompanies them, symbolising the flare of love and the freedom of traveling. Top Notes: Gentle rice Heart Notes: Frangipani blossom Base Notes: Musk

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Touch Of Pink Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=Q32JJ3F]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Lacoste Touch of Pink for women is the feminine expression of an authentic and carefree sensuality. A fragrance for independent and spontaneous women with the magnetism of vitality. Fashioned in vibrant pink and white, the Lacoste Touch of Pink bottle embodies the scent's effortless charm.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Red Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=TN8D8OG]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Lacoste Red. An aftershave fragrance for active, competitive men who flourish in challenging situations that require risk-taking. This is just the extra boost of energy and confidence a man needs...

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Pour Femme Eau de Parfum 90ml Spray
listings.description: Released in 2003, this is a beautifully feminine fragrance that is both energetic and uplifting. It has top notes of pepper and bergamot, sensual heart notes of heliotrope, jasmine and hibiscus and warm base notes of cedar wood and gaiacwood.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Pour Femme Eau de Parfum 50ml Spray
listings.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=J6LUJLF]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll} Lacoste Pour Femme is an elegant woody musky fragrance that embodies the free spirit of today's women. The fragrance is beautifully feminine, energetic and uplifting. Top Notes: Jamaican pepper, Purple freesia. Heart Notes: White heliotrope flower, Iranian jasmine, Hibiscus flower, Bulgarian rose, Ambrette seed. Base Notes: Himalayan cedarwood, Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Essential Eau de Toilette 125ml Spray
listings.description: Lacoste Essential is sophisticated yet bright, fresh yet comfortable, spirited yet complex and classic yet modern. Lacoste Essential is about enjoying freedom in a hectic world. There's an immediacy, a spontaneity and a freshness to the fragrance each time you experience it. Lacoste Essential will be as fresh as the moment you sprayed it on.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste Pour Elle Sparkling Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: A floral fruity gourmand fragrance described as being cute, cheerful and playful with a "French signature". It opens with mandarin orange, red apple, spices, and blackberry, moving into a heart composed of cotton candy, lily-of-the-valley, and macarons, and settling on a base of patchouli, vetiver, cashmere and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste Pour Elle Natural Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: A floral fruity fragrance said to be mood-lifting, authentic and warm, it opens with pineapple, raspberry leaf and mandarin, heart notes of woody, powdery orris root, jasmine and rose, and a base of coconut, sandalwood, and amber.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste Pour Elle Elegant Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 2015 as a part of the L.12.12 Pour Elle collection, it is announced as a classic scent for a confident woman, always fresh and relevant. This floral woody musk fragrance begins with notes of citrus oils, cassis buds, and pink pepper; blending with mimosa, violet, and lily of the valley; and base notes of vetiver, vanilla, and heliotrope.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Rouge Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Lacoste L 12 12 Rouge eau de toilette spray for men is described as a fresh and spicy perfume, opening with top notes of Mandarin, Mango and Tea, flowing into a heart of Black Pepper, Ginger and Cardamom, all of which sits on top of a smooth base of Acacia, Benzoin and Rockrose.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: L.12.12. Blanc is a pure classic floral woody fragrance. Top notes are grapefruit, cardamom, rosemary and cedar leaf, mixed with the core of Mexican tuberose and ylang-ylang. Sensual notes of leather, suede and cedar form the base.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Jaune Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: L.12.12. Jaune is a scent that triggers optimism, joy and positive energy. The inventiveness and elegance of the Lacoste polo shirt revisited in a fragrance. A light and energizing fragrance to make you feel optimistic with the first rays of sunshine.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Challenge Eau de Toilette 90ml Spray
listings.description: Lacoste Challenge opens with fresh and energetic notes of tangerine and lemon, augmented by a burst of lavender. The middle accord is driven by spices including ginger, while the powerful base notes of rosewood and teak bring a modern edge and reinforces the heritage of the brand.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Energized Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: Celebrate your passion for the game with the new Eau de Lacoste Energized Edition! Lacoste has spiced up their iconic Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc with an edgy note of excitement. The original has been spiced up in the top with fiery ginger and a hint of cool mint to enhance the scent’s energetic freshness. The signature tuberose heart of Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc remains untouched but is shaped in the base by masculine leathery and cedar wood notes.

listings.rawTitle: Lacoste Live Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 100ml Spray
listings.description: A dynamic fragrance with an energetic composition. It reflects the fashion statement of Lacoste with its legendary short sleeves polo shirt. Fragrance Family: Green Notes Top Notes: Lime Heart Notes: Green leaves, Aquatic notes Base Notes: Gaiac wood, Licorice, Iris.

listings.rawTitle: Lady Gaga Fame Black Fluid Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Lady Gaga Fame is the first perfume to be endorsed by singer Lady Gaga. Released through the singer's Haus Laboratories label in association with Coty, Inc. The perfume utilizes a "push-pull technology", rather than a pyramidal structure, to bring out its notes of Atropa belladonna, Tiger Orchid, incense, apricot, saffron, and honey. It is stated to be the first black-colored perfume to spray clear and turn invisible once airborne.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Tresor In Love Eau de Parfum 75ml Spray
listings.description: Lancome Tresor in Love captures the spirit of the first moment of love. Nectarine accord and bergamot enchant with a radiant burst of youth. Turkish rose essence and jasmine reveal your feminine side. Cedarwood and musk creates a warm, modern effect.

listings.rawTitle: Lancome Poeme Eau de Parfum 100ml Spray
listings.description: Launched in 1995, this scent is unusual in that it is based on a single floral bouquet of blue poppy, mimosa, jonquil, freesia, rose, and vanilla rather than the more common multi-layered composition of most fragrances.
